errors.notSignedIn: You are not signed in. Sign in again and repeat what you were doing.
errors.notAllowed: You do not have access to this. Ask the system administrator for access.
errors.readOnlyAccount: Your account reads records but does not change them. Ask a colleague with write access to make the entry.
errors.routeNotFound: That page does not exist. Check the link or go back to the home page.
errors.unitNotFound: The unit was not found, or you have no access to it. Pick one of your own units, or ask the system administrator for access.
errors.floorNotFound: There is no such floor in this unit. Pick a floor from the unit's area tree.
errors.userNotFound: No user has the address {email}. Check the address, or load the sample data again.
errors.badRequest: The request is not valid. Check what you sent and try again.
errors.emailNeeded: An email address is needed. Fill it in and try again.
errors.areaNotValid: The area is missing something. Fill in the code, the name, the type and the risk group, then try again.
errors.areaCodeTaken: Code {code} is already in use on this floor. Give the area a different code.
errors.auditQueryNotValid: The search terms are not usable. Check the record type and the record id, then try again.
errors.projectNotFound: The project was not found, or you have no access to it. Pick a project from one of your own units.
errors.projectNotValid: The project is missing something. Fill in the title, the category, the budget and the funding source, then try again.
errors.projectQueryNotValid: The list settings are not usable. Check the filters, the sort order and the page number, then try again.
errors.phaseChangeNotValid: A phase change needs the new phase and a reason. Fill in both and try again.
errors.phaseNotNext: A project moves one phase at a time, forwards only. Pick the next phase, or ask the system administrator to move the project back.
errors.gateOpen: Milestone {milestone} closes the current phase and is not done yet. Record its actual date, then move the project on.
errors.baselineFixed: The milestone's baseline date stays at {baseline} and does not change. Put the movement in the forecast date or the actual date.
errors.milestoneNotFound: There is no such milestone on this project. Reload the page and pick one from the list.
errors.milestoneNotValid: The milestone is missing something. Fill in the title and the baseline date, then try again.
errors.riskNotFound: There is no such risk on this project. Reload the page and pick one from the list.
errors.riskNotValid: The risk is missing something. Write the description and give a likelihood and an impact from 1 to 5.
errors.issueNotFound: There is no such issue on this project. Reload the page and pick one from the list.
errors.issueNotValid: The issue is missing something. Write the description and try again.
errors.contractorNotValid: The contractor is missing something. Fill in the name and the category, then try again.
errors.contractorNotFound: There is no such contractor. Reload the page and pick one from the register.
errors.contractorNameTaken: {name} is already in the contractor register. Open the record that exists, or give this one a different name.
errors.blacklistAdminOnly: Only the system administrator blacklists a contractor or lifts a blacklisting. Ask them to record the change and the reason for it.
errors.contractNotFound: The contract was not found, or you have no access to it. Pick a contract from a project in one of your own units.
errors.contractNotValid: The contract is missing something. Fill in the number, the type, the award date and the original value, then try again.
errors.contractNoTaken: Contract number {contractNo} is already in use in your unit. Use the number on the award decision.
errors.contractorBlacklisted: {contractor} is blacklisted and takes no new contract. The ones already running carry on as they are.
errors.projectNotAwarded: {project} has not been awarded yet, so it cannot hold a contract. Move the project to the award phase first.
errors.boqNotValid: The bill of quantities is not usable. Give every line an item number, a description, a unit, a quantity and a rate.
errors.boqItemNoRepeated: Two lines carry the same item number. Give each line its own.
errors.variationNotFound: There is no such variation on this contract. Reload the page and pick one from the list.
errors.variationNotValid: The variation is missing something. Write the description, pick a reason, and give the value and the time impact in days.
errors.variationDecisionNotValid: The decision is not usable. Choose approve, return or reject, and write a comment where one is needed.
errors.variationNotEditable: The variation is no longer yours to change. You can change it while it is a draft, or while it has come back with comments.
errors.variationNotSubmitted: The variation is not waiting for a decision. You decide on variations that have been submitted.
errors.notRaiser: A variation stays with the person who raised it. Ask the colleague who wrote it to make the change.
errors.sameUserApproval: You cannot approve a variation you raised yourself. Pass the decision to someone else who may approve.
errors.commentRequired: Returning or rejecting a variation needs a comment. Write what has to change, then send the decision again.
errors.budgetFinanceOnly: From the approval phase onwards, only finance changes the approved budget. Ask them to record the change.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again shortly, and tell the estates technical team if it keeps happening.

exceptions.milestoneSlip: Milestone {milestone} on {project} ({unit}) is {days} days behind its baseline date.
exceptions.noPlannedDates: {project} ({unit}) has no planned start and finish dates.
exceptions.finishOverdue: {project} ({unit}) is in progress and its planned finish passed {days} days ago.

warnings.variationsOverTenPct: Approved variations on contract {contract} for {project} ({unit}) now come to {pct} of the original value, {amount} over the 10% mark.
warnings.bondExpired: The performance bond on contract {contract} for {project} ({unit}) expired on {date}. Ask the contractor to renew it.
warnings.completionPast: Contract {contract} for {project} ({unit}) was due to finish on {date}, {days} days ago. Record an extension, or move the project to practical completion.

ruleNames.V01: Estimated total ties to actual plus forecast
ruleNames.V05: Budget article is present and valid
ruleNames.V06: Date and amount cells are typed correctly
ruleNames.V08: A completed project has spent what it planned
ruleNames.V11: Column totals tie to the file
ruleNames.V12: External funding fits inside the project cost

rules.V01: The estimated total ({total}) does not equal actual spend plus the forecast years ({sum}); the difference is {diff}. Check the row in the file and correct the amount in the system after the import.
rules.V02: The estimated total cost is missing. The project is imported with a zero amount and needs its budget from Technical Services.
rules.V03: The category is missing, so the default {category} was applied. Record the category in the system.
rules.V04: The unit «{value}» is not recognised. Add this spelling as an alias of the unit and run the import again.
rules.V05: The budget article «{value}» is missing or is not one of {articles}. Without it the row cannot be matched to SAP, so ask Technical Services for it.
rules.V06: Cell {column} holds text where {expected} belongs: «{value}». Fix the cell type in the file and run the import again.
rules.V07: The finish date ({finish}) comes before the start date ({start}). Fix the dates in the file and run the import again.
rules.V08: The project is reported complete, but actual spend reaches {pct} of the estimated cost and stays under {min}. Confirm the status or the spend.
rules.V09: The project is in preparation and carries a contractual commitment at the same time. Move it to the phase it belongs in after the import.
rules.V10: Actual spend is negative ({value}). Fix the amount in the file and run the import again.
rules.V11: Column {column} adds up to {imported}, while the file's own total says {footer}; the difference is {diff}. Check the file's totals before committing the import.
rules.V12: External funding ({funding}) is larger than the estimated total cost ({total}). Settle which of the two is right before importing.
rules.V13: Another row already has this unit ({unit}) and this title, at row {other}. Give one of the two projects a distinct title.
rules.V14: The forecast for {year} in column {column} is negative ({value}). Fix the amount in the file.

report.title: Import reconciliation report — capital budget
report.totalsIntro: Each column is added up from the project rows and compared with the total the file itself carries, to the cent.
report.message: What is wrong and what to do
report.noPrevious: There is no previous import under this profile, so there is nothing to compare with.
report.diffRemoved: Projects no longer in the file
report.removedIntro: These projects came into the register from an earlier import and are not in this file. They are not deleted. Check whether their title changed.
report.deferredColumn: Column {column} was read but is not imported while rule {until} does not pass: {rows} rows, {sum} in total.
report.unmappedValue: The value «{value}» in column {column} is not in the profile's lookups (rows {rows}). Add it to the profile or fix the file.
report.defaultApplied: The default {what} was applied to {count} rows.
report.verdictStopped: Nothing was written to the database. The rows read do not match what the profile expects, so check the file or update the profile and run the import again.
report.verdictBlocked: The run stayed a dry run because rules {rules} did not pass. Fix what section 4 lists and run the import again.
report.verdictDryRunClean: Every blocking rule passed. Run the same command again with --commit to write the data.
report.verdictCommitted: The import finished: {created} projects created and {updated} updated.

inspect.title: File inspection
inspect.sheetLine: Sheet «{sheet}», header on row {row}, data from row {first}.
inspect.noProblems: Every column in the profile was found under the same header.
inspect.movedLine: Column {column} of the profile expected «{expected}» and found «{found}». Find where it moved to and update the profile.
inspect.unknownLine: Column {column} with header «{found}» is not in the profile. Add it, or list it explicitly as ignored.
inspect.missingLine: Column {column} of the profile («{expected}») is empty in the file. Check whether it moved.

errors.countMismatch: The file gave {project} project rows and {footer} footer rows, where the profile expects {expectedProject} and {expectedFooter}. Nothing was written. Run inspect first, find which column or which footer line moved, and update the profile.
errors.noIdentity: The import needs a user. Run the command again with --as <email address>, so the audit trail shows who imported the file.
errors.userNotFound: No user with the address {email}. Check the address or ask the system administrator to register you.
errors.notAllowed: The account {email} may not run an import. An import writes to every unit, so only the system administrator runs it.
errors.fileMissing: No file at {file}. Check the path and try again.
errors.sheetMissing: The workbook has no sheet «{sheet}». It has: {sheets}. Fix the sheet name in the profile.
